key_claims.claim: A plasma cell-free RNA machine-learning classifier can distinguish uterine leiomyosarcoma from leiomyoma preoperatively in a prospective multicenter cohort.
AI-assisted mammography workflow deployed across 109 U.S. sites raised generalist radiologists' cancer detection rates toward specialist-level performance.
A multimodal deep-learning model integrating MRI and pathology predicts post-resection HCC survival better than conventional staging systems across six centers.
Weight cycling is associated with greater intermuscular fat accumulation in thigh muscle on MRI, independent of net weight change.
An AI histopathology model quantifying tumor heterogeneity achieves C-index 0.761 for PDAC survival prediction across five independent cohorts.
